questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Consider the following statements regarding energy consideration in reference to Bernoulli's principle:
1. Pitot tube indicates the position of total energy line above any arbitrary datum.
2. In rotational flow, velocity varies normal to the flow.
3. The piezometric head in a uniform pipe does not remain constant in the direction normal to the flow for rotational flow.
4. In a real fluid, the total head varies throughout the normal section in a uniform pipe.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.questionText: Consider the following statements regarding energy consideration in reference to Bernoulli's principle: 1. Pitot tube indicates the position of total energy line above any arbitrary datum. 2. In rotational flow, velocity varies normal to the flow. 3. The piezometric head in a uniform pipe does not remain constant in the direction normal to the flow for rotational flow. 4. In a real fluid, the total head varies throughout the normal section in a uniform pipe. Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanationHtml:
(b)
Statement 3 is incorrect. Piezometric head in a uniform pipe remain constant in a direction normal to flow for rotational flow.

questions.questionText: Consider the following statements: 1. Dilatant fluid is shear thickening fluid increasing its resistance with increasing strain rate. 2. Nikuradse's test results are plotted on a logarithmic scale with friction factor f as ordinate and
Reynold's number Re as abscissa. Choose the correct statements:
1. For Re < 2000, friction factor follows a linear relationship with Re.
2. For high values of Re and pipes with very small relative roughness, friction factor is governed by Re and thickness of laminar sub-layer.

questions.questionText: Nikuradse's test results are plotted on a logarithmic scale with friction factor f as ordinate and Reynold's number R e as abscissa. Choose the correct statements: 1. For R e < 2000, friction factor follows a linear relationship with R e . 2. For high values of Re and pipes with very small relative roughness, friction factor is governed by R e and thickness of laminar sub-layer. 3. In rough turbulent flow, f versus R e relationship becomes parallel to R e axis.
questions.explanationHtml:
(a)
Statement 2 is false. For high values of Re and pipes with very small relative roughness, friction factor is governed by Re only.

questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Choose the correct statements for flow occurring from left to right:
1. If streamlines are straight and diverging then only convective tangential positive acceleration exists.
2. If streamlines are curved and equidistant then there will be only normal convective acceleration.
3. If streamlines are curved and converging then both normal and tangential acceleration exist.
4. If streamlines are straight and parallel to each other then there is no acceleration.
questions.questionText: Choose the correct statements for flow occurring from left to right: 1. If streamlines are straight and diverging then only convective tangential positive acceleration exists. 2. If streamlines are curved and equidistant then there will be only normal convective acceleration. 3. If streamlines are curved and converging then both normal and tangential acceleration exist. 4. If streamlines are straight and parallel to each other then there is no acceleration.
questions.explanationHtml:
(b)
Statement 1 is false. If streamlines are straight and diverging then only convective tangential
retardation i.e. negative acceleration exists.

Statement (I): Provision of air vessels on the suction and delivery side of the reciprocating pump increases the delivery head of the pump.
Statement (II): Air vessels reduce the acceleration head and makes the discharge uniform.

Statement (II): Air vessels reduce the acceleration head and makes the discharge uniform.
questions.explanationHtml:
(b)
Air vessels save lot of work required to be done against the frictional resistance in suction and
delivery pipes and thus, delivery head increases.

Statement (II): Vanes on the hub of Kaplan turbine are adjustable.
questions.questionText: Consider the Statement (I) and Statement (II) and choose the correct option using the codes given below: (a) Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are correct and Statement (II) is the correct explanation of Statement (I). (b) Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are correct but Statement (II) is not the correct explanation of Statement (I). (c) Statement (I) is correct but Statement (II) is incorrect.
